WITH 
inventory_sorted AS (
  SELECT 
    i.product_id,
    i.location_id,
    i.qty as available_qty,
    p.purchased as purchase_date,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.product_id ORDER BY p.purchased ASC, i.qty ASC) as inv_rank
  FROM inventory i
  JOIN purchases p ON i.purchase_id = p.id
),
order_lines AS (
  SELECT 
    order_id,
    product_id,
    qty as order_qty,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY order_id) as ord_rank
  FROM orderlines
),
-- For each order, calculate how much inventory is consumed by previous orders
order_cumulative AS (
  SELECT 
    ol.product_id,
    ol.order_id,
    ol.order_qty,
    ol.ord_rank,
    -- Sum of order quantities before this order
    SUM(ol2.order_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY ol.product_id ORDER BY ol.ord_rank ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) - ol.order_qty as prev_total_ordered,
    -- Sum of order quantities at this order (cumulative)
    SUM(ol2.order_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY ol.product_id ORDER BY ol.ord_rank ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) as total_ordered_cuml
  FROM order_lines ol
  LEFT JOIN order_lines ol2 ON ol2.product_id = ol.product_id AND ol2.ord_rank <= ol.ord_rank
),
-- For each order, find the start inventory rank
order_start_rank AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    olc.product_id,
    olc.order_id,
    olc.order_qty,
    olc.ord_rank,
    -- Find the inventory rank that starts this order's allocation
    (
      SELECT MIN(inv2.inv_rank)
      FROM inventory_sorted inv2
      WHERE inv2.product_id = olc.product_id
        AND inv2.inv_rank > (
          SELECT MAX(inv3.inv_rank)
          FROM order_lines ol3
          CROSS JOIN inventory_sorted inv3
          WHERE inv3.product_id = olc.product_id
            AND inv3.inv_rank <= (
              -- Find where previous orders ended
              SELECT MIN(inv4.inv_rank)
              FROM inventory_sorted inv4
              WHERE inv4.product_id = olc.product_id
                AND (
                  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(inv5.available_qty), 0)
                  FROM inventory_sorted inv5
                  WHERE inv5.product_id = olc.product_id
                    AND inv5.inv_rank < inv4.inv_rank
                ) >= (
                  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ol6.order_qty), 0)
                  FROM order_lines ol6
                  WHERE ol6.product_id = olc.product_id
                    AND ol6.ord_rank < olc.ord_rank
                )
            )
        )
    ) as start_rank
  FROM order_cumulative olc
),
-- Simplified: just allocate sequentially
allocation AS (
  SELECT 
    ol.product_id,
    ol.order_id,
    ol.order_qty,
    inv.product_id,
    inv.inv_rank,
    inv.available_qty,
    inv.purchase_date,
    -- Inventory available from this rank onwards
    (SELECT SUM(inv2.available_qty) 
     FROM inventory_sorted inv2 
     WHERE inv2.product_id = ol.product_id 
       AND inv2.inv_rank >= inv.inv_rank) as inv_from_rank,
    -- Order qty remaining after previous orders
    (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ol2.order_qty), 0)
     FROM order_lines ol2 
     WHERE ol2.product_id = ol.product_id 
       AND ol2.ord_rank < ol.ord_rank) as prev_ordered,
    -- Order qty remaining after previous orders for this specific order
    (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ol3.order_qty), 0)
     FROM order_lines ol3 
     WHERE ol3.product_id = ol.product_id 
       AND ol3.ord_rank < ol.ord_rank 
       AND ol3.order_id = ol.order_id) as prev_for_order
  FROM order_lines ol
  CROSS JOIN inventory_sorted inv
  WHERE ol.product_id = inv.product_id
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  product_id,
  order_id,
  order_qty,
  prev_ordered,
  prev_for_order,
  inv_from_rank,
  -- Allocation: min(order_qty - prev_for_order, inv_from_rank)
  LEAST(order_qty - prev_for_order, inv_from_rank) as alloc_qty
FROM allocation
WHERE order_qty - prev_for_order > 0
  AND inv_from_rank > 0
ORDER BY product_id, order_id, inv_rank
LIMIT 60
